desc: 小方木块六面印字母数字与图案，边认读边堆叠一物多玩
leaf: 儿童六面印花字母数字认知小方木块（标准颗粒、四面以上印刷图案、可堆叠可认读）
name: 六面印花字母数字认知方块款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清这是六面带印刷图案的认知小方木块，而不是素色积木或塑料小颗粒，抢点击并满足白底主图合规。
详情页首屏一秒讲清最大购买理由：大字标题加一排四个图标位，把认知启蒙与玩法一次抛出，承接主图点击。
shots.textZone: headline field in the upper half, one support line beneath it, a row of four icon frames inside the scalloped band

shots.intent: 用三格并排把同一套方块搭成三种不同主题，让人一秒看见玩法容量与可延展性，替家长回答能玩多久。
shots.textZone: headline above the row, one pill label at the top-left corner of each card

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实玩的世界：一张聊天气泡框里的堆高画面让家长代入自家孩子，同时用尺度感说明颗粒好不好抓。
shots.textZone: one short heading placeholder above the bubble card

shots.intent: 把印刷面本身当成卖点摊开：字母、数字、图案各面一次看全，证明一套同时是建构件和认知卡，值不值看内容量。
shots.textZone: one pill label beside the flagged cube

shots.intent: 用一张微距让印刷与木面自己说话：墨色压进木纹、边缘不糊，质感证明替代任何无法核实的安全话术。
shots.textZone: one scalloped caption badge at the lower left holding a single short label

shots.intent: 把倒角、印刷对位与木面收尾三处手感相关结构串成一条阅读小径，逐条回应会不会刮手、图会不会印歪。
shots.textZone: one short label beside each of the three crops

shots.intent: 把单块边长与搭完高度用标尺位和参照块说清，消掉颗粒太小好不好抓、搭起来占不占地方的疑虑。
shots.textZone: dimension rules around the measured cube on the left, two short label rows under the anchor at the right

shots.intent: 并排给出两档组合，让买家在同一屏完成选款与凑单决定，替商家抬客单而不是靠促销喊话。
shots.textZone: headline above the row, one pill label under each card

shots.intent: 收掉风险：把到货内容摊成一屏，配虚线规格栏与三个编号要点位，让参数由卖家填真值而不是由模版编结论。
shots.textZone: dashed spec frame with six generic field-name rows, headline above it, three numbered badge labels under the kit

shots.intent: 详情页最后一屏收口：仰视把成品墙拍出气势，配一个明确的按钮动作把看完的犹豫转成加购。
shots.textZone: clean headline field above the wall, rounded CTA button below the headline

style.backgroundSystem: #A9DDEF and #F7F0DC fields joined by scalloped cloud-edge dividers; rounded photo cards and speech-bubble cards filled #FFFFFF and outlined #EFA9BD; at most one #F6D3AF panel and one dashed #FFFFFF spec frame per screen; no photographic clutter behind infographic screens
style.direction: bright candy-pastel early-learning block ecommerce, picture-book playfulness with strict infographic discipline
style.iconSystem: rounded-square frames outlined #EFA9BD holding single-weight #2E2A4A line pictograms, scalloped numbered circle badges in #F2C4CE and #A9DDEF, one #7BB661 dashed path line linking vertically stacked cards; no filled emblems, no certificate artwork, no seals
style.lightingSystem: daylight-balanced 5500K soft key from the upper left, wide bounce fill on the shadow side, true contact shadows under every cube, controlled highlights on printed faces, short raking light only inside macro crops, no harsh speculars, no dramatic falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright candy-pastel early-learning block ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #A9DDEF field, #F7F0DC field and #F6D3AF panel, with #2E2A4A label ink, #F7D948 display fill, #EFA9BD card outline and one swappable highlight {accent_color}; neutral daylight tone; one rounded geometric sans-serif family, heavy rounded display headlines filled #F7D948 with a #2E2A4A outline at 34-46pt, tracked-out uppercase Latin sublines at 13-16pt and labels at 10-14pt in #2E2A4A; background system of #A9DDEF and #F7F0DC fields joined by scalloped cloud-edge dividers with rounded #FFFFFF cards outlined #EFA9BD, at most one #F6D3AF panel and one dashed #FFFFFF spec frame per screen; lighting system of a 5500K soft key from the upper left, wide bounce fill and true contact shadows under every cube; surface system of matte #FFFFFF sweep, #F7F0DC board and #F6D3AF panel; icon system of rounded-square frames outlined #EFA9BD holding single-weight #2E2A4A pictograms, scalloped numbered circle badges in #F2C4CE and #A9DDEF and one #7BB661 dashed path line; cube faces always rendered true to the reference with real ink-in-grain texture, stable cube scale, radius and finish, never floating without a contact shadow, no identifiable child face in any screen; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no redrawn printed artwork, no QR codes, no store badges, no membership copy.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent colors beyond {accent_color}
no mixed fonts, no handwritten, serif or cartoon lettering
no random backgrounds and no stock-photo interiors on infographic screens
no inconsistent lighting direction and no missing contact shadows
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge artwork
no redrawn, restyled or invented printed artwork on any cube face
no QR codes, no store badges, no membership copy, no watermark
style.presentationRules: cube colors, printed faces, proportions and corner radii come only from the reference image and never change between screens; printed artwork is never redrawn, restyled or invented; the same build keeps the same scale, radius and finish across the set; at least one overhead and one low camera in every set; product never floats without a contact shadow; no identifiable child face in any screen
style.surfaceSystem: matte #FFFFFF sweep for packshot and face-inventory screens, #F7F0DC board for play and spec surfaces, #F6D3AF panel for bundle and trust screens; surfaces stay clean, unwrinkled, debris-free
style.typography: one rounded geometric sans-serif family across Chinese and Latin; heavy rounded display weight for headlines only (34-46pt, filled #F7D948 with a #2E2A4A outline), regular weight for sublines (13-16pt, uppercase and tracked out) and labels (10-14pt) in #2E2A4A; all in-image copy rendered only as short 「{selling_point_N}」 and 「{callout_N}」 placeholders, per-screen budget under 40 characters
